content.text: they heard the voice of the Lord God, Gen. 3:8. God heard the voice of the lad, Gen. 21:17. Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard, Gen. 45:2. heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters, Ex. 3:7 (Acts 7:34). people may hear when I speak with thee, Ex. 19:9. I will hear what the Lord will command, Num. 9:8. Hear now, ye rebels, Num. 20:10. ye heard the voice of the words, Deut. 4:12. Did ever people hear the voice of God … and live, Deut. 4:33. Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord, Deut. 6:4 (Mark 12:29). Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord, Deut. 18:16. that they may hear, and … learn, Deut. 31:12. hear, O earth, the words of my mouth, Deut. 32:1. Speak, Lord; for thy servant heareth, 1 Sam. 3:9. Samuel cried … for Israel; and the Lord heard him, 1 Sam. 7:9. Lord will not hear you in that day, 1 Sam. 8:18. loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off, Ezra 3:13. Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray … and he shall hear, Ps. 55:17. iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear, Ps. 66:18. Zion heard, and was glad, Ps. 97:8. hear the instruction of thy father, Prov. 1:8 (13:1). Hear instruction, and be wise, Prov. 8:33. he heareth the prayer of the righteous, Prov. 15:29. he that heareth reproof getteth understanding, Prov. 15:32. He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, Prov. 18:13. words of wise men are heard in quiet, Eccl. 9:17. Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, Isa. 1:2 (D&C 76:1). when ye make many prayers, I will not hear, Isa. 1:15. Hear ye indeed, but understand not, Isa. 6:9 (Matt. 13:14; Mark 4:12; Luke 8:10; Acts 28:26; 2 Ne. 16:9). that which they had not heard shall they consider, Isa. 52:15 (Rom. 15:21). not heard, nor perceived by the ear, Isa. 64:4 (1 Cor. 2:9). have ears, and hear not, Jer. 5:21. When they fast, I will not hear their cry, Jer. 14:12. hear thy words, but they will not do them, Ezek. 33:31. I heard, but I understood not, Dan. 12:8.

whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, Matt. 7:24 (3 Ne. 14:24). He that hath ears to hear, let him hear, Matt. 11:15 (13:9, 43; Mark 4:9; Luke 8:8). seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, Matt. 13:23. heard of the fame of Jesus, Matt. 14:1 (Mark 6:14; Luke 9:7). beloved Son … hear ye him, Matt. 17:5 (Mark 9:7; Luke 9:35; JS—H 1:17). ye shall hear of wars, Matt. 24:6 (Mark 13:7; Luke 21:9; D&C 45:26; JS—M 1:23). have heard his blasphemy, Matt. 26:65 (Mark 14:64; Luke 22:71). unto you that hear shall more be given, Mark 4:24. common people heard him gladly, Mark 12:37. Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard, Luke 1:13. midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them, Luke 2:46. he that heareth, and doeth not, Luke 6:49. He that heareth you heareth me, Luke 10:16. spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light, Luke 12:3. If they hear not Moses and the prophets, Luke 16:31. dead shall hear the voice of the Son, John 5:25. all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, John 5:28. Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, John 7:51. because ye cannot hear my word, John 8:43. He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, John 8:47. God heareth not sinners: but if any … doeth his will, him he heareth, John 9:31. porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice, John 10:3. other sheep … shall hear my voice, John 10:16 (3 Ne. 15:17–24). My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, John 10:27. Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me, John 11:41. if any man hear my words, and believe not, John 12:47. all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known, John 15:15. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice, John 18:37. how hear we every man in our own tongue, Acts 2:8. when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, Acts 2:37. speak the things which we have seen and heard, Acts 4:20. speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man, Acts 9:7. Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard, Acts 10:44. not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost, Acts 19:2. witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard, Acts 22:15. how shall they hear without a preacher, Rom. 10:14. ears that they should not hear, Rom. 11:8. they that have not heard shall understand, Rom. 15:21. written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, 1 Cor. 2:9. into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, 2 Cor. 12:4. both save thyself, and them that hear, 1 Tim. 4:16. not being mixed with faith in them that heard it, Heb. 4:2. if ye will hear his voice, harden not, Heb. 4:7. every man be swift to hear, James 1:19. this voice which came from heaven we heard, 2 Pet. 1:18. which we have heard, which we have seen, 1 Jn. 1:1. he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us, 1 Jn. 4:6. ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us, 1 Jn. 5:14. hear the words of this prophecy, Rev. 1:3. if any man hear my voice, and open the door, Rev. 3:20.

Hear ye the words of the prophet, 1 Ne. 19:24. wo unto the deaf that will not hear, 2 Ne. 9:31. I had heard the voice of the Lord, Jacob 7:5. God did hear our cries, Mosiah 9:18. I will be slow to hear their cries, Mosiah 11:24. he that will not hear … I will not receive, Mosiah 26:28. Lord hath heard the prayers of his people, Mosiah 27:14. multitude did see and hear, 3 Ne. 17:25. Lord did hear the brother of Jared, Ether 1:40.

no … ear that shall not hear, D&C 1:2. they who will not hear the voice of the Lord, D&C 1:14. testify that you have heard my voice, D&C 18:36. mine elect hear my voice, D&C 29:7. Ye hear of wars, D&C 38:29 (45:63). hear the word of the Lord, D&C 70:1. shall hear the voice of the Son of Man, D&C 76:16. that which you hear is as the voice of one crying, D&C 88:66. every man shall hear … gospel in his own tongue, D&C 90:11.
they heard the voice of the Lord God … in the garden, Moses 4:14 (4:16). My Beloved Son. Hear Him, JS—H 1:17.
